analysis.one_line_summary: Two girls demonstrate the Wavytalk thermal round brush transforming thick, frizzy curly hair into a smooth, bouncy blowout.
analysis.full_description: A video where a girl styles her friend's thick curly hair using the Wavytalk thermal brush. Starting with a quick teaser of the bouncy wave, they show the step-by-step curling process on front sections, a half-and-half progress check, a close-up section roll, and conclude with fully styled blowout hair.

hook.first_frame: Standing girl holding a curled lock on her friend's curly hair.
hook.visual_0_3s: Friend points at a freshly smoothed, curled front strand.

narrative_beats: Step-by-step front section curl test and reaction
Repeat curl process on top section
Final transformation reveal and conviction statement
pain_points: Difficult to straighten/style dense curly hair
objections_handled: Works even on very curly, frizzy, high-volume hair textures
social_proof: References popular trend: 'I see girls doing like this'

talent.hair_before: Dark brown, thick, high-volume 3C/4A curly hair
talent.hair_after: Smooth, glossy, voluminous loose blowout curls

analysis.notes: Organic viral UGC format repurposed as a paid ad. Authentic demonstration on difficult hair texture drives high proof of concept.
